_repo: dses. Scope is site/ only. The specification markdown at the repository root (DSES-v0.2.md, CLAIMS-CLASSIFICATION.md and the rest) is normative spec text, not site copy, and is deliberately out of scope. Point the guard at it explicitly with --root . if that ever changes.
_comment: Language guard v2 allowlist. Every entry records the ruling that made the string acceptable. Adding an entry without a ruling date is a process violation. Scoped suppression: set "rules" to an array of rule ids, or omit for all rules.

gatedPhraseFamily.note: Pinned family. The word 'gated' is permitted only inside these four phrases.

allow.note: Ruled acceptable as written and frozen at this level of description. Sits adjacent to a prohibited mechanism in meaning but names no mechanism. Never expand it. Current live instances are on evidify.ai (index.html, platform.html, for-research.html). Kept here so both repos carry one ruleset.

allow.note: dses.ai section 4. Describes a non-strippable binding and is semantically adjacent to a prohibited mechanism, but states a governance requirement, not an enforcement mechanism. Ruled acceptable as written.

allow.note: dses.ai hero assertion. Ruled acceptable alongside R-4a as a deliberate voice choice. 'Proof' is a noun about sequence, not a claim about fault.

allow.note: The required verbatim disclaimer for any insurance copy. It necessarily contains the two prohibited claim phrases, so it is allowlisted for the claim-overreach rule only. Nothing else may contain them.
The required first standalone body use: adjective plus noun. Not a bare-noun subject.
